parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

>  You must specify this parameter if your database instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID. You can obtain the task ID from the response parameters of the [CreateKillInstanceSessionTask](~~609246~~) operation.
